diagnosis: The tenant audit log endpoint relies on IP whitelisting using the client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header as the primary authorization mechanism for accessing tenantId data. Because it trusts the header without verifying user session tenancy, an attacker can set X-Forwarded-For to the victim tenant's corporate CIDR and read sensitive administrator audit trails and security events.
